final: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS status_avg FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(sa.avg_faces - b.overall_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(sa.avg_faces - st.status_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_averages AS sa JOIN status_averages AS st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.avg_faces > st.status_avg
